findings: F: SPECIALIST_ROLES in orchestrator/foundation/contracts.py is exactly (zeko, cto, cfo, kai, somad, badsector, nova) — 7 specialists, orchestrator excluded from the specialist set.

F: orchestrator/organization/ is the bounded organization layer: MissionPacket/MissionTask (packet.py), plan_waves (waves.py), TypedHandoff (handoff.py), EvidenceLedger (evidence.py), ReworkLedger with MAX_REWORK_CYCLES=2 (rework.py), RootVerdict/build_verdict (root.py), MissionRunner (runner.py).
F: MissionRunner executes waves through orchestrator/runtime/parallel.ParallelExecutor — the single existing bounded-concurrency executor; no second scheduler exists in the layer.
F: EvidenceLedger records into the existing RuntimeAudit append-only ledger (orchestrator/runtime/audit.py) via the sanctioned audit channel; no second audit store exists.

F: Reviewer verdicts are typed vocabularies: BADSECTOR PASS/REWORK/REJECT (control/badsector.py VALID_VERDICTS), SOMAD VERIFIED/REWORK/REFUTED (organization/rework.py); accept verdicts are PASS and VERIFIED.
F: orchestrator/organization/metrics.py exposes MissionMetrics with an explicit OBSERVED vs ESTIMATED split; cfo_estimates is populated only from a CFO handoff.

F: mission-level metrics vocabulary (mission_id, started_at, duration_ms, task_count, completed/blocked/failed/escalated, rework_cycles, roles_invoked/completed, waves, parallel_tasks_peak, verification_passed/failed) is present on MissionMetrics.
F: wave planning (orchestrator/organization/waves.py plan_waves) partitions the task DAG into maximal independent sets — NOVA+CFO share wave 0; BADSECTOR+SOMAD share the review wave.
risks: R: reviewer-role ownership rules (reviewer cannot self-fix) must be enforced at the packet layer, not by convention.

cfo.summary: ESTIMATED: resource recommendation — run the remaining waves with the existing DEFAULT_MAX_WORKERS bound (max 4 workers); waves 0 and 3 are maximal independent sets of size 2, so no wave needs more than 2 concurrent workers; no additional spawning beyond the fixed role set.
findings: ESTIMATED: resource recommendation — run the remaining waves with the existing DEFAULT_MAX_WORKERS bound (max 4 workers); waves 0 and 3 are maximal independent sets of size 2, so no wave needs more than 2 concurrent workers; no additional spawning beyond the fixed role set.
NO-DATA: no token/cost telemetry is available in this run; no cost figures are asserted. Any token/cost number would be invented.

ESTIMATED: budget note — rework budget is bounded at 2 cycles per worker task (MAX_REWORK_CYCLES=2 in orchestrator/organization/rework.py); worst-case review loop for the implementation task is 2 rework cycles then escalate, so plan capacity for at most 2 re-review dispatches, not an open retry loop.

ESTIMATED: resource recommendation — reviewers (badsector, somad) are read-only and can run concurrently with zero write contention; sequencing them in one wave is the resource-optimal bound under the existing ParallelExecutor.
OBSERVED: the mission is bounded to 1 run with each specialist invoked exactly once for the canonical smoke (7 dispatches plus at most 2 bounded rework re-dispatches).
risks: R: ESTIMATED figures in this handoff must never be merged into OBSERVED mission metrics; estimates could be mistaken for observations if the fields are combined.
R: if rework exceeds the 2-cycle budget the mission must escalate rather than continue consuming resources.

cto.summary: DECISION: reuse the existing organization layer unchanged for the canonical smoke — MissionPacket/MissionTask, plan_waves, ParallelExecutor, RuntimeAudit-backed EvidenceLedger, ReworkLedger(2), BadSectorGate provenance, build_verdict. No second scheduler, no second audit system, no L3/live-bridge change, no release-system change.

DECISION: the canonical smoke artifact is a harmless test fixture set under tests/organization/fixtures/ plus mission evidence under runs/7role_smoke/ — no repository source mutation beyond the additive metrics/instrumentation already verified by tests.
DECISION: wave flow is fixed — W0 nova+cfo (parallel), W1 cto, W2 kai, W3 badsector+somad (parallel review), W4 zeko (gated on both review tasks), W5 ROOT verdict.
DECISION: per-role/per-task durations and attempts are collected as OBSERVED runner data; CFO estimates stay in the ESTIMATED cfo_estimates section only.
DECISION: model-level subagent identity is NOT asserted — the persona composition is DRAFT/NOT MOUNTED (6/6 channel attempts failed); role identity is enforced at the packet/ownership layer instead.
risks: R: replaying recorded results through MissionRunner proves the organization layer but not model-level child identity — reported as a blocker, not papered over.
R: any new executor or audit store introduced for the smoke would violate the hard scope; none is introduced.

findings: ATTACK SURFACE REVIEWED: scope — the smoke fixture set (tests/organization/fixtures/7role_*.json) and the smoke driver (runs/7role_smoke_driver.py).

CHECK PASSED: no authority-bearing keys in the smoke payloads (no delegation, authorization, approval, signature, policy, permission, token, secret, credential keys) — build_task_context's boundary would reject them.
CHECK PASSED: the driver does not write outside runs/7role_smoke/; fixture files are static JSON with no executable content.
CHECK PASSED: no second scheduler and no second audit store introduced — driver reuses MissionRunner/ParallelExecutor/RuntimeAudit.
CHECK PASSED: OBSERVED and ESTIMATED remain separated — cfo_estimates is a distinct section and is excluded from OBSERVED classification in MissionMetrics.to_dict().
CHECK PASSED: fail-closed paths intact — reviewer verdicts are typed (not prose-parsed), ROOT refuses COMPLETE without done+evidence+accepted reviews, rework budget is 2 then escalate.
risks: R: the smoke proves the organization layer, not model-level subagent identity; treated as a known blocker rather than a review finding against the artifact.

findings: INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION: re-derived the claims from the artifacts themselves, not from BADSECTOR's review — this verification does not cite BADSECTOR as proof.
VERIFIED: wave plan of the 7-role packet is exactly (nova,cfo) -> (cto) -> (kai) -> (bad,som) -> (zeko), checked via orchestrator/organization/waves.plan_mission_waves.
VERIFIED: metrics collector counts tasks per lineage root; a reworked task is counted once with attempts = 1 + rework cycles (reproduced in TestReworkInMetrics).

VERIFIED: ROOT verdict refuses COMPLETE when evidence or reviewer acceptance is missing (reproduced in TestRootFailClosed), and ZEKO cannot be dispatched past a rejected review (TestZekoCannotOverrideRejectedReview).
VERIFIED: cfo_estimates populated only from a CFO 'done' handoff; absent otherwise (TestObservedVsEstimated).
VERIFIED: single scheduler (orchestrator.runtime.parallel.ParallelExecutor is the runner's engine) and single audit (EvidenceLedger wraps the passed RuntimeAudit instance, no own store path).
